name: Sweet Pea & Sorrel
tagline: Flower shop & studio. Small bouquets, tied by hand in Carroll Gardens.
bio: A made-up example: a tiny flower shop in Brooklyn. Seasonal bouquets wrapped in paper, flowers for weddings and small events, and an evening bouquet workshop once a month.

shop.title: Bouquets for pickup
shop.note: Tied the morning you pick them up, with whatever is best that week.
shop.where: Pickup at the shop in Carroll Gardens

items.name: Small market bouquet
items.desc: Poppies, ranunculus and greens, wrapped in paper.

items.name: The big bunch
items.desc: A full armful for a table or a big thank-you.

terms: Free to cancel up to 7 days before. Inside 7 days, half the quote.

experiences.name: Bouquet workshop for your team
experiences.desc: An evening at the flower bench: pick your stems, learn to tie a hand-held bouquet, and take it home wrapped.
includes: A bouquet each to take home

experiences.name: Flowers for your event
experiences.desc: Table arrangements, a welcome piece and small bouquets for a dinner, launch or small wedding.
includes: A call to plan colors and flowers
Delivery and setup in Brooklyn and Manhattan

past.title: Spring bouquet night
past.note: Our first workshop at the shop.
past.about: Twelve people, a long bench and buckets of ranunculus and poppies. Everyone tied a bouquet and took it home.

past.title: Mother's Day pickup
past.about: Pre-ordered bouquets, wrapped and ready to pick up, with coffee on the stoop.

past.title: Peony and poppy workshop
past.about: A hands-on evening with peonies and poppies at their best. Snips, twine and a bouquet each to take home.
